reviews.text: We booked a panicked 1-to-1 session with Ben the first week of having our goldendoodle puppy and Ben was a huge lifesaver! His advice and exercises in that session were perfectly tailored to what we needed and we signed up for the puppy classes after that. Overall we’ve been wildly impressed with Ben and the amount of bespoke advice you get for the price is really outstanding value for money. I was particularly pleased at how well it all aligned with the Easy Peasy Puppy Squeezy training book which meant we could have the book for the basics/as a reference but then Ben could support with reinforcing, giving us advice and troubleshooting, and advising other options that could work better for our pup. Really outstanding dog training by a lovely human, can’t recommend more.

Ben is a fantastic trainer... enthusiastic, fun, knowledgeable and great at helping you learn how to work with your dog. He makes you feel at ease and we really enjoyed our training with him.

We attended puppy and improver classes with Ben and have been reaping the rewards of a well mannered dog ever since. He walks calmly on the lead, ALWAYS comes back when I call and will happily sit still for as long as I want... strangers frequently comment on how well behaved he is!

I would highly recommend Gatsby and Poole.

Whether you are a first time puppy owner or on your 7th dog like me Gatsby & Poole is the best training class to visit.
Not only is it amazing to meet someone who is so enthusiastic about your dogs …

Cannot recommend Ben highly enough! Both the pre-vaccination visit and the puppy classes have given us the best foundations for our puppy Pablo and for ourselves as owners too. The classes are informal and friendly and we learnt a lot in just one hour sessions (and Pablo loved them!)
Just completed the 6 week puppy class. Great enthusiastic funny knowledgeable teacher, have learnt all the basics just need to practice at home now. Thoroughly recommend.
